2607.04848.title: SynSFX: Multi-Model Sound Effects Synthesis Dataset for Deepfake Detection and Evaluation
2607.04848.paper_summary: While audio deepfake detection has advanced significantly, representative detectors show limited generalization to synthetic sound effects. Existing environmental audio datasets such as EnvSDD provide important initial resources, but remain limited in scale and generation provenance for studying isolated sound-effect deepfakes. To support this direction, we present SynSFX, a large-scale corpus of 43374 clips (26452 synthetic, 16922 real) spanning 7 popular text-to-audio models.
2607.04848.paper_summary_zh: 雖然音頻深偽檢測已顯著進步，但代表性的檢測器在合成音效方面的泛化能力有限。現有的環境音頻數據集如EnvSDD提供了重要的初始資源，但在研究孤立的音效深偽時仍然在規模和生成來源上受到限制。為了支持這一方向，我們提出了SynSFX，一個包含43374個片段（26452個合成，16922個真實）的超大規模語料庫，涵蓋了7個流行的文本到音頻模型。
